messages.subject: “micro_era5” error in  `[<-`(`*tmp*`, 4, njc[1], value = as.numeric(substr(line.read,  : subscript out of bounds
parts:
Hi Mike，
Thanks for your contributions in NicheMapR, the "micro_era5" function is very useful, but recently I used again, met an error in  `[<-`(`*tmp*`, 4, njc[1], value = as.numeric(substr(line.read,  : subscript out of bounds

I thought the error may happen before :request_era5(request = req, uid = uid, out_path = op),because the previous .nc document I used in micro_era5 is successful,

below is my codes, is there anything wrong with my codes? 


library(NicheMapR)
library(ecmwfr)
library(mcera5)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(tidync)
library(microclima)
library(keyring)
library(ncdf4)

# get ERA5 data with package mcera5 (just do once for region and time of interest)

# assign your credentials (register here: https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/user/register)
uid <-"xxxxx"
cds_api_key <- "xxxxxxxx"

ecmwfr::wf_set_key(user = uid, key = cds_api_key, service = "cds")

# bounding coordinates (in WGS84 / EPSG:4326)
xmn <- 108
xmx <- 115
ymn <- 38
ymx <-42



# temporal extent
st_time <- lubridate::ymd("2020:06:30")
en_time <- lubridate::ymd("2020:09:30")

# filename and location for downloaded .nc files
file_prefix <- "era5_IM"
op <- "/Users/jiangzhongwen/Desktop"

# build a request (covering multiple years)
req <- build_era5_request(xmin = xmn, xmax = xmx,
                          ymin = ymn, ymax = ymx,
                          start_time = st_time,
                          end_time = en_time,
                          outfile_name = file_prefix)
str(req)
request_era5(request = req, uid = uid, out_path = op)

# run micro_era5 for a location (make sure it's within the bounds of your .nc files)

dstart <- "10/07/2020"
dfinish <- "30/08/2020"

loc <- c(111, 40) 
micro<-micro_era5(loc = loc, dstart = dstart, run.gads = 2,dfinish = dfinish, spatial = '/Users/jiangzhongwen/Desktop/era5_IM')

Best wishes,
